sky: Sun enters Sagittarius. Moon in Aries until about 4:30 pm IST, then Taurus. Moon trine Mars and Jupiter in Leo. Moon opposite Venus in Libra. Mars in Leo square the Sun at the end of Scorpio. Mercury in Scorpio.

hook.vo: Three signs get good news today. One sign should stay quiet. Which one are you?

signs.vo: Aries. Your confidence is back. Make the first move before evening.
signs.l2: Make the first move before evening

signs.vo: Taurus. Slow morning, strong evening. After sunset, the day is yours.
signs.l2: After sunset, the day is yours

signs.vo: Gemini. Reply to that old friend. One message opens a door.
Cancer. Your work gets noticed today. Leave the stress at the office.
signs.l2: Leave the stress at the office

signs.vo: Leo. Luck is loud for you today. Say yes, but skip the argument.
Virgo. Check the numbers before you pay. Someone owes you an answer.
Libra. Everyone wants your yes today. Choose yourself first.
Scorpio. This one is you. Stay quiet today. Do not send that text.
signs.l2: Stay quiet. Do not send that text

signs.vo: Sagittarius. Your season starts today. Begin the thing you kept delaying.
Capricorn. Slow down today. Home needs one full hour of you.
signs.l2: Home needs one hour of you

signs.vo: Aquarius. Speak up in the group. Your idea is the one that lands.
signs.l2: Your idea is the one that lands

signs.vo: Pisces. Ask for what you are worth. The money talk goes your way.
signs.l2: The money talk goes your way

cta.vo: Comment your sign. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
